description: Aménagements Cyclables is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Service SIG - Ville d'Aix en Provence. Cycling facilities of the city of Aix en Provence (GIS Service). Coverage: Service SIG - Ville d'Aix en Provence. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle fittings" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Service SIG - Ville d'Aix en Provence. Its keywords include aix-en-provence, amenagements, cyclable, aix, amenagements-cyclable, velo. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2022-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
